title: Builds a POSIX shell CLI with safe environment and argument quoting
prompt: Create only bin/render-env.sh as a portable POSIX sh script. It must require exactly two positional arguments and exit 2 with a usage message otherwise. For valid input, print exactly [target] first :: second plus one newline, where target is DEPLOY_TARGET or local when unset. Preserve spaces and Unicode in every value. Run sh verify.sh; do not modify verify.sh. When it passes, reply with exactly SHELL_ENV_OK.

files.verify.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
rm -f .passed
actual=$(DEPLOY_TARGET='blue team' sh bin/render-env.sh 'alpha beta' 'Crème brûlée')
[ "$actual" = '[blue team] alpha beta :: Crème brûlée' ] || { echo "bad env output: $actual" >&2; exit 1; }
actual=$(unset DEPLOY_TARGET; sh bin/render-env.sh gamma delta)
[ "$actual" = '[local] gamma :: delta' ] || { echo "bad default output: $actual" >&2; exit 1; }
if sh bin/render-env.sh only-one >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'missing-argument call unexpectedly passed' >&2
  exit 1
else
  code=$?
fi
[ "$code" -eq 2 ] || { echo "wrong usage exit: $code" >&2; exit 1; }
printf 'ok\n' > .passed
echo 'SHELL ENV PASS'
